label: 1 - Capture audio to CSV
info:
Arduino Nano 33 BLE Sense (USB serial) -> Node-RED -> one CSV file per recording, under data/<category>/.

Click one of the four 'Record: ...' inject nodes to trigger one recording. Each click sends a single 'R' byte to the board, waits for the REC_START ... REC_END block it streams back, and writes it as data/<category>/<category>_NN.csv, NN counting up from 01 for that category.

Edit the serial-port config node's port to match `ls /dev/tty.*` (macOS/Linux) or your COM port (Windows) before deploying.
